pages.text: If you place a biome brazier in the range of a shrine to your current dimension (overworld/nether/end), you can light it with the prime material of your current dimension (salt/sulfur/quicksilver) and it will keep its chunk loaded.
This costs 9 spirits from the shrine upon lighting and 9 more each sunrise.$(br2)For modded dimensions, use an overworld shrine and cinnabar.
